description.zh:
账号备注信息，备注信息需满足如下要求：
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
* 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the account. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

title.zh: 修改数据库账号的备注信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-account-description --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --account-name testacc --account-description test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountDescription --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription test --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000' --AccountName testacc
